option_relations.rationale: Allergic fungal rhinosinusitis is a condition affecting the nasal passages and sinuses, not directly related to the symptoms of nerve palsy described.
The symptoms described, such as binocular horizontal diplopia and inability for the left eye to track beyond the midline, are consistent with abducens nerve palsy.
Chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps is a condition affecting the nasal passages and sinuses, not directly related to the symptoms of nerve palsy described.
Iatrogenic Abducens Nerve Palsy is a specific type of abducens nerve palsy caused by medical intervention, which aligns with the post-procedure examination findings.
